description: This file defines functions related to DispatchKey and BackendComponent enums, including conversion to string, mapping from device types, parsing from strings, and operator overloads for output streams. It is part of the PyTorch core dispatch mechanism.

methods.name: toString(BackendComponent)
methods.description: Converts a BackendComponent enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: toString(DispatchKey)
methods.description: Converts a DispatchKey enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: operator<<(DispatchKey)
methods.description: Overloads the output stream operator for DispatchKey.

methods.name: operator<<(BackendComponent)
methods.description: Overloads the output stream operator for BackendComponent.

methods.name: getAutogradKeyFromBackend
methods.description: Returns the autograd DispatchKey associated with a given BackendComponent.

methods.name: parseDispatchKey
methods.description: Parses a string to return the corresponding DispatchKey enum value.
